issue_title: Epic: open-source ConferenceOS with no ATA residue
problem_statement:
Epic: open-source ConferenceOS with no ATA residue

**Context.** `events.allthingsai.org` (All Things AI, "ATA") now has its own repo, [The-AIE/ata-events-site](https://github.com/The-AIE/ata-events-site) (private, created from `conference-os` `ata/release` at dc6a041e, then synced to main e0db0061). Old-host redirects for 2025/2026.allthingsai.org live in [The-AIE/ata-legacy-redirects](https://github.com/The-AIE/ata-legacy-redirects). We want ConferenceOS to be open source with **no ATA-specific code, data or docs** in its tree. History is allowed to stay (gitleaks over all 3,378 commits found no secrets: 4 matches, all test placeholders).

## Goal
A public `conference-os` repo whose **tree** contains no All Things AI code, data, docs or infra IDs, published with full git history. ATA keeps its own code only in `ata-events-site`.

## Decisions already made

## Scan results (2026-10-11)

## Size of the job
342 files mention ATA: 161 tests, 67 `src`, 50 docs, 39 scripts, 10 prisma data, a handful of root docs/config. ~27 non-test files are ATA-specific; ~70 more are incidental mentions in comments/examples.

## Work (sub-issues)
Phase 1 is started on branch `chore/oss-cleanup` (WIP, **not mergeable**: 126 ATA-only files deleted, runtime references not yet fixed).

## Acceptance
